result:
The change that stopped it is PR #6346, merged as commit `c21a7cbfa2c9f67c1991372a343217e949e04f44` on 2026-07-17. It adds `concept == null` to the condition that gates the ConceptName full-text search, so that search only runs when no concept is supplied. The PR is titled "TRUNK-6683: Skip full-text search with drugs when a concept is provided", and its body says it restores pre-2.8.x behaviour for a performance gain.

**Evidence, best first:**

1. **The fix:** `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java` lines 1582-1583. The condition is now `if (searchDrugConceptNames && concept == null)`, with a comment about skipping the expensive concept-name search when a concept is supplied. Before the change it was only `if (searchDrugConceptNames)`.
2. **Where the gated search lives:** the same file, `newDrugQuery` at lines 1574-1593. The `SearchQueryUnique.findUniqueKeys` call on ConceptName is what the fix skips. The result is an empty `conceptIds` list when a concept is passed.
3. **Entry point:** the same file, `getDrugs(...)` at lines 1562-1572, which calls `newDrugQuery`.
4. **Service delegation:** `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ConceptServiceImpl.java` lines 1579-1582 forwards `getDrugs` straight to the DAO, so the service needed no change.
5. **Public API signature:** `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/ConceptService.java` line 1686, with the matching DAO declaration at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/ConceptDAO.java` line 476.
6. **Regression test, concept supplied:** `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAOTest.java` lines 125-157. This adds two tests. `getDrugs_shouldNotSearchConceptNamesWhenConceptIsSupplied` checks that a concept-name-only match ("ZEBRACONCEPT") does not pull in an unrelated drug when a concept is passed. `getDrugs_shouldSearchConceptNamesWhenNoConceptIsSupplied` checks that the lookup still runs when no concept is passed.
7. **Test data:** `openmrs-core/api/src/test/resources/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/include/HibernateConceptTestDataSet.xml` lines 46-49 add concept 20 named "ZEBRACONCEPT" and its drug "Placebo-X".
8. **The PR itself:** `openmrs-core` PR #6346, which lists the three changed files and the merge commit above. Falkon also links it to TRUNK-5111 by title pattern, which I did not verify.

**Caveat on "redundant":** the PR says the change restores earlier behaviour for performance rather than describing the extra results as duplicates. I did not check whether the concept-name hits could ever have added results beyond the concept filter. The tests only show that a name-only match no longer leaks in when a concept is given.
